title: Graytness & Grayton Dreams
meta_description: Side-by-side Grayton homes sleeping 64 across 22 BRs, with two private pools, game room, golf carts, and a two-block walk to the beach via shuttle.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Graytness \& Grayton Dreams by AvantStay! These two homes sit right next door to each other on Grayton Village Road, with a combined 22 bedrooms sleeping 64 guests --- ideal for large family trips, milestone celebrations, or groups looking to spread out without splitting up.
⠀
Grayton is one of 30A's most beloved stretches, known for sugar-white sand, turquoise water, and a barefoot, low-key energy locals have protected for decades. The walkable village delivers live music at The Red Bar, Gulf views from Chiringo, and a tight collection of surf shops and galleries. Hike Grayton Beach State Park, paddle the coastal dune lake at Western Lake, or drive east to Seaside and WaterColor when the group wants a change of scenery. Between the two homes, the group has a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, two 6-seater golf carts, and eleven adult bikes, plus the free Grayton Central shuttle a short walk away --- putting the beach a two-block ride from the front door.
⠀
Graytness
Four levels with an elevator give Graytness room to gather and room to breathe. A kitchen built for a crowd --- two refrigerators, two stoves, two dishwashers --- opens to a dining table that seats 26 and a pillow-soft sectional, with an adjacent den and Smart TV for kids or smaller groups to peel off.
⠀
Sleeping is built for balance: eight king bedrooms across the upper two floors for quieter retreats, two bunk rooms with full-over-full beds for a more social energy, and an eleventh bedroom anchoring the bottom floor near the game room --- its own world with a pool table, Smart TV, and just enough distance to let the night take on its own rhythm.
⠀
Outside, the pool and spa anchor long afternoons, and the screened porch sets the scene for al fresco dinners off the built-in outdoor kitchen and grill, with a 6-seat table, bistro set, and overhead fans keeping things easy.
⠀
Grayton Dreams
Grayton Dreams picks up the same rhythm across its own four levels. Open main living spaces and multiple gathering areas keep the energy moving --- coffee in the kitchen, conversations carrying from one room to the next, no one competing for space.
⠀
King suites sit across the upper floors for quiet retreats with private or semi-private baths, while the bunk rooms bring a more playful energy for kids or friends settling in for late-night conversations. Downstairs, the game room becomes its own world --- pool games stretching into the evening, something always on the TV.
⠀
Outside, a private pool invites long, unstructured afternoons, and the covered balcony sets the scene for dinners that linger --- grilling, passing plates, eating together in the open air as the day winds down.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Golf cart use requires a signed liability waiver

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking is available for 5 cars max.
- Paid parking is available at Grayton Storage Facility.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit: STR-12215

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
